# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: fluentbit-sidecar
description: A Helm chart for deploying a multi-container Pod with Fluent Bit log-shipping sidecar
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
# Default values for fluentbit-sidecar.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.
# Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

replicaCount: 1

image:
  repository: nginx
  tag: latest
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

fluentbit:
  image:
    repository: fluent/fluent-bit
    tag: latest
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  config:
    # Fluent Bit configuration
    input: |
      [INPUT]
          Name              tail
          Path              /var/log/app/*.log
          Parser            json
          Tag               app.*
          Refresh_Interval  10
          Mem_Buf_Limit     5MB
          Skip_Long_Lines   On
    output: |
      [OUTPUT]
          Name              stdout
          Match             *
    parser: |
      [PARSER]
          Name        json
          Format      json
          Time_Key    time
          Time_Format %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%L
          Time_Keep   On

service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 80

resources:
  main:
    limits:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 512Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
  fluentbit:
    limits:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 50m
      memory: 64Mi

nodeSelector: {}

tolerations: []

affinity: {}

# Shared volume configuration
sharedVolume:
  # Path where the main application writes logs
  appLogPath: /var/log/app
  # Path where Fluent Bit reads logs
  fluentbitLogPath: /var/log/app
  # Volume size limit
  sizeLimit: 1Gi

# Additional environment variables for main container
env: []
# - name: MY_VAR
#   value: "my_value"

# Additional environment variables for Fluent Bit container
fluentbitEnv: []
# - name: FLUENT_BIT_VAR
#   value: "my_value"

# Pod annotations
podAnnotations: {}

# Security context
podSecurityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  runAsGroup: 1000
  fsGroup: 1000

containerSecurityContext:
  main:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    capabilities:
      drop:
        - ALL
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  fluentbit:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    capabilities:
      drop:
        - ALL
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "fluentbit-sidecar.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "fluentbit-sidecar.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride }}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride }}
{{- if contains $name .Release.Name }}
{{- .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "fluentbit-sidecar.chart" -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Chart.Name .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "fluentbit-sidecar.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "fluentbit-sidecar.chart" . }}
{{ include "fluentbit-sidecar.selectorLabels" . }}
{{- if .Chart.AppVersion }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
{{- end }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "fluentbit-sidecar.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "fluentbit-sidecar.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "fluentbit-sidecar.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "fluentbit-sidecar.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "fluentbit-sidecar.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      {{- with .Values.podAnnotations }}
      annotations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      labels:
        {{- include "fluentbit-sidecar.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      {{- with .Values.podSecurityContext }}
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      containers:
        - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          env:
            {{- toYaml .Values.env | nindent 12 }}
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: {{ .Values.service.port }}
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources.main | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: shared-logs
              mountPath: {{ .Values.sharedVolume.appLogPath }}
          securityContext:
            {{- toYaml .Values.containerSecurityContext.main | nindent 12 }}
        - name: fluentbit
          image: "{{ .Values.fluentbit.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.fluentbit.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.fluentbit.image.pullPolicy }}
          env:
            {{- toYaml .Values.fluentbitEnv | nindent 12 }}
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources.fluentbit | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: shared-logs
              mountPath: {{ .Values.sharedVolume.fluentbitLogPath }}
              readOnly: true
            - name: fluentbit-config
              mountPath: /fluent-bit/etc/fluent-bit.conf
              subPath: fluent-bit.conf
              readOnly: true
            - name: fluentbit-config
              mountPath: /fluent-bit/etc/parsers.conf
              subPath: parsers.conf
              readOnly: true
          securityContext:
            {{- toYaml .Values.containerSecurityContext.fluentbit | nindent 12 }}
      volumes:
        - name: shared-logs
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: {{ .Values.sharedVolume.sizeLimit }}
        - name: fluentbit-config
          configMap:
            name: {{ include "fluentbit-sidecar.fullname" . }}-fluentbit-config
      {{- with .Values.nodeSelector }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.affinity }}
      affinity:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.tolerations }}
      tolerations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "fluentbit-sidecar.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "fluentbit-sidecar.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.service.type }}
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
      name: http
  selector:
    {{- include "fluentbit-sidecar.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "fluentbit-sidecar.fullname" . }}-fluentbit-config
  labels:
    {{- include "fluentbit-sidecar.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
data:
  fluent-bit.conf: |
    [SERVICE]
        Flush        1
        Daemon       Off
        Log_Level    info
        Parsers_File parsers.conf

    {{ .Values.fluentbit.config.input | nindent 4 }}

    {{ .Values.fluentbit.config.output | nindent 4 }}
